items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: I said, well, Benzie, fix it like that.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. It's a reason that the man didn't write it all on there like he should have. I had it on another piece of paper somewhere. Let me see. Somewhere else I had it. The man didn't fix it correctly. He fixed it like that. I said, well, Benzie, fix it like that. I'm going to carry it home. I ain't going to say no more to the man because he might mess it up.
